name: OrbitLoader
description: A compact loader with two counter-rotating orbit rings carrying satellites around a softly breathing accent core, implemented with CSS keyframes.
a11yNotes: Root uses role="status" with an aria-label (default 'Loading'); all visual parts are aria-hidden. Under prefers-reduced-motion rotation and breathing stop, leaving a static orbit composition.

propsApi.name: duration
propsApi.description: Outer orbit period in seconds; the inner ring runs at twice this, reversed.

propsApi.name: color
propsApi.description: Accent color for the core and leading satellite.

propsApi.name: label
propsApi.description: Accessible label exposed via aria-label on the status element.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.
